pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Friendship and Keeping Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Use Friendship and Keeping Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Friendship and Keeping Promises.
   C. Apply the teaching of Friendship and Keeping Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Friendship and Keeping Promises has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Physical Aspect of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Use Physical Aspect of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Physical Aspect of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical Aspect of Yoga.
   D. Say Physical Aspect of Yoga has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Stories and Family Values? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Stories and Family Values.
   B. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Stories and Family Values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Scriptural Stories and Family Values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Scriptural Stories and Family Values has no place in daily life.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

5. Which response best shows understanding of Medicinal Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Use Medicinal Trees to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Medicinal Trees with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Medicinal Trees has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Medicinal Trees.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Say Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship and Keeping Promises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Physical Aspect of Yoga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Medicinal Trees and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Friendship and Keeping Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Physical Aspect of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Scriptural Stories and Family Values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. B — Apply the teaching of Medicinal Trees with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. B — Apply the teaching of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. A — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Physical Aspect of Yoga; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Medicinal Trees; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
